newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to shut firms that evade taxes - Fernandez.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to shut firms that evade taxes - Fernandez.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez said Friday authorities will be relentless in their campaign to shut firms that do not pay their taxes.
"They will have to accept it," Fernandez told reporters. "It's an offer they (businesses) can't refuse. If they don't pay taxes, they will be shut.
"We will be very hard about this. Let there be no doubt."
The government has estimated that it loses about $20 billion, or half the national budget, a year in unpaid taxes.
